title: Partnerships
subtitle: The federations ARIS is in talks with, from first contact to a signed agreement and the opening of their space.
emptyHint: Record the first federation you contacted to follow the relationship through to the agreement.

form.newHint: Only countries in the list with neither a federation nor a live partnership are offered. A country can stay inactive until it is opened.
form.editHint: The country does not change; change the stage from the record.
form.noFreeCountry: Every country in the list already has a federation or a partnership. Add the country under “Supported countries”.
form.countryHint: Not there? Add it under “Supported countries” first (it can stay inactive).
form.codeHint: The code it will carry on ARIS, for example FSF.
form.noteHint: The context: where, how, with whom.

stage.title: Change stage
stage.declineHint: Declining closes this record; a fresh approach can be opened later.

onboard.title: Open {name} on ARIS
onboard.hint: The agreement is signed: everything is created at once, or nothing if something gets in the way.
onboard.countryActivated: {country} will be switched on in the supported countries list.
onboard.federationCreated: The federation will be created with agreement {reference}.
onboard.seatCreated: Its first seat will be created: that person can sign in straight away.
onboard.seatLocaleHint: The language of their space and their notifications.
onboard.passwordHint: Send it through another channel than the welcome e-mail; they can change it.

errors.future_date: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.partnership_exists: A partnership with this country is already under way.
errors.already_partner: This country already has a federation on ARIS.
errors.bad_transition: This stage cannot be reached from the current one.
errors.not_signed: Only a signed agreement lets you open the federation.
errors.invalid_owner: The owner must be an active administrator.
errors.closed: This partnership is closed and can no longer be changed.
